experiments.carry_reason: The event's costings end before the population's first year. The measure is a permanent change of level whose last costing year is steady state, so later years compare with that year, scaled to the run year's base.
experiments.note: Without the freeze the April 2017 uprating would have applied: the November 2016 forecast's RPI for 2017, 3.192% (RPI!K19), on 57.95p. Later freezes keep the higher level and the 2022 5p cut is in cash, so modern law's 52.95p becomes 54.800p in 2024-25 and 2025-26. pe-uk's fuel_duty covers household car fuel only, so business and haulage fuel in the OBR's base are outside it.
sources: OBR Historical official forecasts database, Spring 2026, sheet RPI
